Official local land-office site was found, including a Ternate-specific land-information procedure article and office identity. It is registry/procedure evidence, not an open parcel geometry service.

Official documentation confirms BHUMI is an interactive spatial map integrated with ATLAS and documents parcel-layer concepts. No safe anonymous Ternate ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Ternate has an evidenced local land-registry custodian and a municipal open-data portal, but current open parcel geometry coverage is not verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if publicly exposed
blocker: No safe anonymous Ternate parcel response containing a stable native ID and geometry was verified. The local portal and national viewer routes were metadata/UI evidence only.
remainingUncertainty: Parcel data may be restricted to an authenticated workflow, a non-indexed layer, or an office procedure. Zero search results and an unusable/empty viewer route do not prove citywide absence, and the exact WUP point was not shifted or used as an absence test.
nextStep: Retry only if the Ternate municipal portal publishes a parcel layer/document or a current public ATR/BPN route yields a safe native-ID-plus-geometry response; qualify any adapter independently before runtime use.
